'''Geska Gesse''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] of the [[Neetakka clan]], who, following the tradition of this young clan, became a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and member of the [[Goa-Ato/Legends|Goa-Ato]] during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. 

==Biography==
Around two [[Standard week]]s after the [[Battle over Coruscant]], [[Nilesk]] of the assignment committee of Goa-Ato considered putting him into a very long and challenging hunt, suitable for the boasting Neetakka's reputation; she suggested the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]'s and [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba's]] double bounty on [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], only to be notified by [[Opdoa]] that [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] had collected it already. Nilesk then placed Geska on the hunt for [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="assign">{{WEGCite|story=New Assignments|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}</ref>
